exposure: Type of sterilization procedure (salpingectomy vs. tubal ligation)
cohort: Patients undergoing sterilization concurrent with cesarean delivery or in the post-vaginal delivery period between January 1, 2015, and December 31, 2017, at the Mayo Clinic Health System (N=152)
finding: Salpingectomy at the time of cesarean delivery or post-vaginal delivery was not inferior to tubal ligation in terms of change in perioperative hemoglobin.
mod_finding: Salpingectomy at the time of cesarean and post-vaginal delivery may be safe as  it did not show inferiority compared to tubal ligation in terms of change in perioperative hemoglobin.
